mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (id, session_id, from_uid, to_uid, group_id, content, msg_type, send_time, is_read) VALUES (#{id}, #{sessionId}, #{fromUid}, #{toUid}, #{groupId}, #{content}, #{msgType}, #{sendTime}, #{isRead})
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, from_uid, to_uid, group_id, content, msg_type, send_time, is_read FROM chat_message WHERE group_id = 0 AND ((from_uid = #{userId1} AND to_uid = #{userId2}) OR (from_uid = #{userId2} AND to_uid = #{userId1})) ORDER BY send_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
